say: Bot Battle is now on Roblox, and it plays the same way as in the browser.
The menu, the three fighters and the paper they fight on all came across, with the CPUs still brawling behind the menu.
Every match opens on the versus screen, each fighter with its line.
The game's code was ported from the web version, and the fighters are its own models, so every move works the same, from the inhale to the compaction slab.
Play takes two to four fighters, each one you, a friend on the same keyboard, or the computer.
Online, you can make a room, join a room by its name, or find a casual match with other players in your server.
Online wins go on a leaderboard shared by every server, and it plays with a keyboard, a gamepad or a phone's buttons.
